Ravi (SRE): Postmortem up: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-batch-spike-2. Need SLO follow-ups and owner assignments.
Nina P: Noted. Key issue: tail latency bursts during 02:50-03:10 UTC. Current SLOs based on avg hide this.
Theo G: We should add a route-level P99.9 SLO and a sustained throughput SLI (5m rolling).
Ravi (SRE): Draft targets: route_p99_9 <= 1200ms at 99.7% and sustained_throughput >= 90% baseline. Validation window 14 days.
Nina P: I'll update SLO docs and flag SLA implications with PM/legal.
Theo G: I'll implement PromQL and dashboards. Use: histogram_quantile(0.999, sum(rate(request_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
Ravi (SRE): Actions:
- Theo: dashboard + alert rules in staging (due Fri)
- Nina: SLO doc + PM sync (due Mon)
- Ravi: tracking ticket RED-4333 and runbook note for "03:00 batch spike"
sre-oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-0330-02 linked.
Ravi (SRE): We'll reconvene next Tue 09:30 for SLO sign-off. React with :white_check_mark: if you accept.
Theo G: :white_check_mark:
Nina P: :white_check_mark: Accepting.
Ravi (SRE): Thanks — closing thread and adding owners to postmortem.
